verdict.rationale: IRCC collects applicants' personal data through accounts, forms and biometrics, so asking whether that data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use opt-outs or a privacy policy on model training. The cited pages cover only work permits, processing times, the Start-up Visa program and account services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
